interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to restrict AoE discovery to (e.g., 'eth0 eth1'), or 'none' to disable discovery, or '' to use all interfaces.

raid_arrays.description: Space-separated list of RAID arrays (without /dev/ prefix) to activate after AoE volumes are ready.

lvm_groups.description: Space-separated list of LVM2 volume groups to activate after AoE volumes are ready.

aoemounts.description: Space-separated list of file systems to mount over AoE. Entries in /etc/fstab containing '/dev/etherd/' are auto-included.
